response.sql: WITH state_counts AS (SELECT BillingState, COUNT(*) AS invoice_count FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), group_stats AS (SELECT invoice_count, SUM(invoice_count) OVER () AS total_count, AVG(invoice_count) OVER () AS average_count FROM state_counts) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices, AVG(1.0 * invoice_count / total_count) AS average_share, AVG(invoice_count - average_count) AS average_excess FROM group_stats WHERE invoice_count > average_count;
